notes: Core site settings. Values live in admin/settings `values`; a site adds its own entries in admin/settings `schema` (same shape; a site entry cannot reuse a core key). `group` is the admin tab, `section` a heading inside it, `description` the (i) text. `client` puts the value in the page config at that path (window.config and handler `config`); `override` lets a sub-site (admin/settings/sites/{host}) set its own value. Secrets never go here: they stay in env.

configSource.label: Page config source
configSource.description: Where the page config comes from. env: the host's `config` JSON (sites not migrated yet). settings: these settings, with env holding only the Firebase config, the service account, origin and secrets.

environment.label: Environment
environment.help: Beta shows a red BETA bar at the top and bottom of every page.
environment.description: Beta shows a red BETA bar at the top and bottom of every page and a thin red frame, so testers never confuse it with the live site. Changes apply on the next page load, no restart.

title.label: Site name
title.description: The site's name: the browser tab title, the home-screen app name and the brand name in the header. A project page's own title replaces it on that page.

description.label: Description
description.description: One or two sentences shown to search engines and in link previews. A project page's own description replaces it on that page.

homeGroup.label: Home group
homeGroup.description: Group id this site belongs to. When set, the main page opens this group's business page, and news, promotions and sign-ups are scoped to it. Leave empty for the whole platform.

logo.label: Logo
logo.description: Logo image in the header: an https URL or a Cloudinary image id. Shown square, about 100 px.

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.description: Short slogan next to the logo in the header on wide screens.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.description: Small icon in the browser tab and bookmarks: an https URL to a .ico or .png image.

icons.label: App icons
icons.description: Home-screen icon URLs by size, for example {"ico144": "https://...", "ico152": "https://..."}.

colorPrimary.label: Primary color
colorPrimary.description: Main theme color: a Material palette name (for example indigo or blue-grey) or a hex color.

colorSecondary.label: Accent color
colorSecondary.description: Accent color for buttons and highlights: a Material palette name or a hex color.

colorPrimaryContrast.label: Text on primary color
colorPrimaryContrast.description: Text color on the primary color (toolbar, primary buttons): light or dark. Unset: the palette's own contrast.

css.label: Custom CSS
css.description: Extra CSS added to every page's head (inside a <style> tag). Use it for small brand tweaks; it can break the layout, so test on beta first.

login.label: Sign-in methods
login.description: Comma-separated sign-in buttons offered, in order, for example Google,Email or Google,Email,Quick Connect. Empty: Google,Email.

stripePublishableKey.label: Stripe publishable key
stripePublishableKey.description: Stripe's publishable key (starts with pk_). It is public by design and is used by checkout pages; the secret key stays in env.

cloudinaryCloudName.label: Cloudinary cloud name
cloudinaryCloudName.description: Cloudinary account name used to show and upload images from the browser. The API key and secret stay in env.

cloudinaryUploadPreset.label: Cloudinary upload preset
cloudinaryUploadPreset.description: Unsigned upload preset the browser uses for image uploads (set up in Cloudinary).

googleClientId.label: Google OAuth client id
googleClientId.description: OAuth client id for Google sign-in and Drive/Calendar pickers in the browser. Public by design.

googleApiKey.label: Google browser API key
googleApiKey.description: Browser API key for Google APIs (pickers, sheets). It is visible to visitors by design, so restrict it to this site's domains in Google Cloud.

googleMapsKey.label: Google Maps key
googleMapsKey.description: Browser key for Google Maps, if a product shows maps. Restrict it to this site's domains.

pushPublicKey.label: Push public key (VAPID)
pushPublicKey.description: Web push public key from Firebase Cloud Messaging, used by browsers to subscribe to notifications.

addonPublicKey.label: Add-on verification key
addonPublicKey.description: Public half (JWK, RSA-PSS) of the key that signs reviewed add-ons; pages use it to verify add-on manifests. The private signing key never goes here (refused).

systemEmailName.label: Sender name
systemEmailName.description: Name shown with the sender email, for example the site name. Handlers get the combined sender as systemSender.

systemEmail.label: Sender email
systemEmail.description: Address system emails come from (invites, PINs, receipts, notifications). Its domain must be set up for sending. A sub-site can send from its own address.
